arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 -B - <<'PY'
import sys,copy
sys.path.insert(0,'submission')
from crosscheck import CrossCheck
T={'nodes':[{'id':8,'name':'Z','external_capacity':12},{'id':4,'name':'A','external_capacity':50}], 'links':[{'source':8,'target':4,'capacity':10}], 'external_nodes':['Z','A']}
S={'trials':32,'epsilon':250000,'seed':4294967295,'cutoff':[0,1],'bias':0,'tau':0,'gamma':[1,1],'cache_slots':2}
c=CrossCheck(T)
assert c.patch({'op':'patch','demands':[[8,4,9]],'counters':{'low_Z_egress_to_A':{'perturbed':8}}})
saved=(c.measured.copy(),c.demands.copy())
invalid=[
 {'demands':None,'counters':{}}, {'demands':{},'counters':{}},
 {'demands':[],'counters':[]}, {'demands':[]},
 {'demands':[[8,4,0],[8,4,1]],'counters':{}},
 {'demands':[[8,4,0],[4,8,True]],'counters':{}},
 {'demands':[[8,4,0],[4,8,1.0]],'counters':{}},
 {'demands':[[8,4,0],[4,8,-1]],'counters':{}},
 {'demands':[[8,4,0],[4,8,1000000001]],'counters':{}},
 {'demands':[[8,4,0]],'counters':{'low_Z_egress_to_A':{'perturbed':10,'bad':0}}},
 {'demands':[[8,4,0]],'counters':{'low_Z_egress_to_A':{'corrected':10}}},
 {'demands':[[8,4,0]],'counters':{'low_Z_egress_to_A':{'perturbed':True}}},
 {'demands':[[8,4,0]],'counters':{'low_Z_egress_to_A':{'perturbed':11}}},
 {'demands':[[8,4,0]],'counters':{'low_Z_egress_to_A':0}},
 {'demands':[[8,4,0]],'counters':{'unknown':None}},
 {'demands':[],'counters':{},'extra':1},
]
for p in invalid:
 p['op']='patch'
 assert not c.patch(p), p
 assert (c.measured,c.demands)==saved
assert c.patch({'op':'patch','demands':[],'counters':{'low_Z_egress_to_A':{'perturbed':None,'ground_truth':True,'corrected':10,'confidence':{'x':'y'}}}})
assert c.measured[c.topology.counter_index['low_Z_egress_to_A']] is None
print('atomic patch rejection okay')

base={'op':'patch','demands':[[8,4,9]],'counters':{'low_Z_egress_to_A':{'perturbed':8}}}
ann=copy.deepcopy(base);ann['counters']['low_Z_egress_to_A']['corrected']={'x':'ignored'}
R={'Z':{'A':[{'path':['Z','A'],'weight':1000}]},'A':{'Z':[{'path':['A','Z'],'weight':1000}]}}
Rs=copy.deepcopy(R);Rs['Z']['A']=[{'path':['Z','A'],'weight':500}]*2
E=[base,{'op':'routes','paths':R,'label':'x'},{'op':'repair','id':'a'},ann,{'op':'repair','id':'b'}, {'op':'routes','paths':Rs,'label':'x'}, {'op':'repair','id':'c'}, {'op':'routes','paths':R,'label':'changed'}, {'op':'repair','id':'d'}, {'op':'patch','demands':[[4,8,1]],'counters':{}}, {'op':'repair','id':'e'}, {'op':'routes','paths':Rs,'label':'x'}, {'op':'patch','demands':[[4,8,0]],'counters':{}}, {'op':'repair','id':'f'}, {'op':'validate','id':'a'}]
a=CrossCheck(T).replay(E,S)
hits=[x['cache_hit'] for x in a if x['op']=='repair']
assert hits==[False,True,False,True,False,False],hits
for i in [2,4,6,8,10,13]:
 print(i,a[i]['op'],a[i].get('cache_hit'))
assert a[2]['links']==a[6]['links']
assert a[2]['links']==a[8]['links']
# publications independent even of equivalent certificate and repeated reports
original=copy.deepcopy(a[4])
a[2]['links'][0][2]=99
for cell in a[2]['counters'].values():cell['confidence'][0]=999
assert a[4]==original
print('semantic caching, snapshots and publication isolation okay')
PY
